unit.why: Mostly footnote-style genealogical notes and yahrzeit (hillula) dates for R. Yehiel Michel of Zlotchov's circle and descendants. Embedded in them is a short anecdote about how R. Michel foresaw his own death and died on the Sabbath.
unit.boundary_note: part of a running series of numbered notes continuing from the previous division into the next

stories.start_quote: עוד קבלתי מנכדיו הנ״ל כי נצו״י
stories.summary_en: On the Sabbath of the joined portions Nitzavim-Vayelekh, R. Yehiel Michel was called to the Torah for the sixth aliyah and heard the verse 'הן קרבו ימיך למות'. He read the verse as a hint of his years and his name, and he died that evening at the third Sabbath meal amid great light.

tags.why: The anecdote is centered on the tzaddik's passing.

quotes: ולעת ערב בסעודה השלישית מגודל האור נסתלק ברעוא עלאה
ולעת ערב בסעודה השלישית מגודל האור נסתלק
tags.why: The events take place on Shabbat, during the Torah reading and the third meal.

quotes: רמז לו הן שנים (כן הי׳ שנותיו) קראו ימיך למות
tags.why: He reads the verse as a sign of his imminent death, which then happens.

quotes: הי״וד של ימיך הוא יחיאל ואותיות הנשארים של ימיך
tags.why: He gives a letter-based exegesis of the verse.
Great light accompanies his death, though the text may mean spiritual light.

quotes: ואמר רבינו זצללה״ה זי״ע שזה. רמז לו
tags.why: He perceives a hidden hint about his own end.
